gold: Tufted angioma with somatic KDR mutation

selector.rationale: The presence of a KDR (VEGFR2) c.C2312G, p.T771R somatic mutation in the affected tissue supports the diagnosis of Somatic KDR (VEGFR2) Mutation-associated Vascular Lesion, which best explains the decisive findings without contradiction.

rejected.label: Cherry Angioma
rejected.why: The lesion's size and composition do not match typical cherry angioma characteristics.

rejected.label: Telangiectasia
rejected.why: While telangiectasias are present, the lesion's overall characteristics and genetic findings suggest a more specific diagnosis.

rejected.label: Cutaneous Angiokeratoma
rejected.why: The lack of angiokeratoma-specific features and the presence of a KDR mutation point away from this diagnosis.
